name: ActivityHD
description_en:
ActivityHD is AccountingWare’s modular accounting and payroll system. Its components include ActivGL for the general ledger, ActivAP for payables, ActivAR for receivables, ActivBR for reconciliation, ActivFA for fixed assets and ActivPR for payroll.

Its distinctive documented workflow combines configurable financial dimensions with Excel reporting that can drill back to source transactions. It may be installed locally or in a cloud-hosted environment; that is not proof of a browser-only application. This profile did not install a client or verify an implementation.
description_zh:
ActivityHD 是 AccountingWare 的模块化会计和薪资系统，包括总账 ActivGL、应付 ActivAP、应收 ActivAR、银行对账 ActivBR、固定资产 ActivFA 和薪资 ActivPR。

官方资料中较有辨识度的流程，是把可配置财务维度与可追溯至源交易的 Excel 报表连接起来。产品可本地安装或在云环境托管，不能据此认定它是纯浏览器应用。本文未安装客户端或验证实施。

core_features.explanation_en: ActivGL classifies transactions with configurable account segments and dimensions.
core_features.explanation_zh: ActivGL 通过可配置科目分段和维度对交易分类。

core_features.explanation_en: Financial report functions retrieve ActivityHD data and link amounts to supporting detail.
core_features.explanation_zh: 财务报表函数读取 ActivityHD 数据，并从金额链接到明细。

core_features.explanation_en: ActivAP describes distribution templates, auditable corrections and separation from ledger staff.
core_features.explanation_zh: ActivAP 介绍分摊模板、可审计更正，以及与总账岗位的职责分离。

sections.title_en: Choose modules around an accounting process
sections.title_zh: 围绕会计流程选择模块
sections.en:
The product family separates ledger, payables, receivables, bank reconciliation, fixed assets and payroll while describing an integrated system. An organization can therefore evaluate how a vendor invoice or payroll liability reaches the ledger, instead of assuming every named module is part of one fixed subscription. AccountingWare also sells ActivReporter for Dynamics GP and offers SwipeClock; those are not interchangeable names for ActivityHD.

The main page allows local or cloud-hosted installation. Request an architecture and module scope suitable for your finance team before treating the generic cloud label as an operating plan. Exact supported versions, infrastructure, Excel dependencies and hosting responsibilities were not fully reviewed here.
sections.zh:
产品家族将总账、应付、应收、银行对账、固定资产和薪资分为不同模块，同时强调集成。组织可以围绕供应商发票或薪资负债如何进入总账来评估，不应认定所有模块都包含在固定订阅中。AccountingWare 还提供面向 Dynamics GP 的 ActivReporter 及 SwipeClock，不能把它们当成 ActivityHD 的别名。

主产品页说明可以本地安装或云托管。应先取得适合财务团队的架构和模块范围，再把“云”视作可执行运营方案。本次未完整核对支持版本、基础设施、Excel 依赖和托管责任。

sections.title_en: Classify a transaction once, then inspect every view
sections.title_zh: 交易分类后检查不同视图
sections.en:
ActivGL supports account segments and dimensions that may be required or optional, validated or freeform, hierarchical and budgetable. It also supports several companies, including different fiscal years, with automatic due-to/due-from postings for intercompany work. These settings define how the accounting data can be analyzed.

For a hypothetical property group, assign an expense to the intended company, location and department, then compare company financials and a department budget report. A balanced company ledger does not prove that the department or entity was correct. Agree the dimension structure and who may change it before importing history; flexibility in the product does not replace a financial policy.
sections.zh:
ActivGL 支持科目分段和维度；维度可设为必填或可选、校验值或自由填写、层级式，并可用于预算。系统还支持多个公司及不同会计年度，内部交易可自动生成往来记账。它们决定财务数据能够如何分析。

以假设的物业集团为例，把费用分配给指定公司、地点和部门，再对照公司财务报表与部门预算。公司账簿平衡并不能证明部门或实体选对了。导入历史前应商定维度结构及修改权限；产品的灵活性不能替代财务政策。

sections.title_en: Excel is part of the report workflow
sections.title_zh: Excel 是报表流程的一部分
sections.en:
The ledger page describes embedded Excel functions that retrieve data from ActivityHD and amounts that drill back to detail postings, subsidiary records and supporting scanned images. This is more specific than a CSV export. It also describes multiple budgets and reporting calendars, and date-based detail for project reporting across fiscal years.

In evaluation, select one report amount and follow it to the source invoice and attachment. Confirm that the intended user can refresh the report and has permission to inspect the detail. This research did not run a workbook, test a desktop configuration or measure refresh performance. Do not present compatibility with every Excel edition or a browser spreadsheet as established.
sections.zh:
总账页面介绍内嵌 Excel 函数，用于从 ActivityHD 读取数据；金额可回查到明细过账、子模块记录及扫描附件。这比简单导出 CSV 更具体。页面还介绍多套预算、报表日历，以及按交易日期明细进行跨会计年度的项目报告。

评估时可选一个报表金额，沿链路查到源发票和附件，并确认目标用户能够刷新报表且有权查看明细。本文未运行工作簿、测试桌面配置或测量刷新性能，不能宣称兼容所有 Excel 版本或浏览器电子表格。

sections.title_en: Payables corrections need an audit trail
sections.title_zh: 应付更正需要审计轨迹
sections.en:
ActivAP describes vendor invoices with attachments, reusable distribution templates, payment preferences and corrections after an invoice is processed and paid. The product says corrected distributions remain synchronized with the ledger and record who changed them and when. It also lists customizable duplicate-invoice checks and intercompany payment distributions.

A useful test would split one supplier bill between departments, approve and pay it, then correct a distribution using an authorized role. Inspect the financial effect and change history. This is a proposed test, not a claim that any edit is permitted without controls. The page distinguishes AP staff from GL staff, with ledger personnel retaining control of the final posting allocation.
sections.zh:
ActivAP 介绍带附件的供应商发票、可复用分摊模板、支付偏好，以及发票处理付款后的更正。厂商说明更正后的分摊与总账保持同步，并记录修改人和时间；还列出可定制重复发票检查和跨公司付款分配。

可以测试将一张供应商账单分到不同部门，审批付款后，再由获授权角色更正分摊，并检查财务影响和修改历史。这是建议测试，不表示任何编辑都能绕过控制。页面区分应付岗位与总账岗位，由总账人员控制最终过账分配。

sections.title_en: A repeatable close still needs accountable operators
sections.title_zh: 可重复结账仍需要负责人员
sections.en:
ActivGL describes reversible year-end closing and re-closing after additional entries, rather than a one-way archive operation. Attachments can support postings and reporting. Its flexibility can be useful where complex allocation, historical detail or project periods matter, but also makes role design and reporting definitions important.

Before migration, compare opening balances and a full period of subsidiary activity with the old system. Evaluate a duplicate invoice, a rejected payment and an authorized correction, then ask for backup and restore evidence in the proposed hosting environment. Those exception and recovery exercises were not performed for this profile. Documented automation capability is not evidence that a specific external integration is configured.
sections.zh:
ActivGL 介绍可撤销的年末结账，以及补记分录后的再次结账，不是一次性不可逆归档。过账和报表可以附带支持资料。这种灵活性对复杂分摊、历史明细或项目期间可能有用，也使角色设计和报表定义更重要。

迁移前，应将期初余额及一个完整期间的子模块交易与旧系统对照。评估重复发票、付款被拒和授权更正，再要求在计划托管环境中提供备份恢复证据。本档案未执行这些异常或恢复检查。存在自动化能力，也不能证明特定外部集成已经配置。

sections.title_en: Obtain a quote for modules and operating requirements
sections.title_zh: 按模块和运营要求取得报价
sections.en:
The official Request a Quote page read on 22 October 2026 asks prospects to contact AccountingWare; no monetary amount was established. Specify the accounting modules, users, company structure, hosting, reporting setup, integrations, conversion/training and support required. These are quote questions, not verified separate charges.

An organization that needs financial dimensions and transaction-level research may find the system worth investigating. Someone wanting only a self-service online invoice page may face more setup than the task warrants. License terms, infrastructure cost and any ongoing maintenance charges remain contract-specific; this research did not establish an open-source license, a permanent free plan or a universal per-user rate.
sections.zh:
2026 年 10 月 22 日读取的官方 Request a Quote 页面要求联系 AccountingWare，没有确立货币金额。询价时需写清会计模块、用户、公司结构、托管、报表配置、集成、转换培训和支持要求。这些是询价问题，不是已核实的独立收费项。

需要财务维度和交易级追查的组织可以进一步评估；只想自助在线开票的用户，实施工作可能超出任务需要。许可、基础设施和持续维护费用仍取决于合同。本次未确立开源许可、永久免费套餐或通用按用户费率。
